note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Equinix Hampton, Georgia xScale project ('Equinix Atlanta Data Center', 1100 Site Parkway, Hampton, Henry County, GA 30228)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas (no Hampton, Site Parkway or Henry County record, no pending fragment or hold). Equinix's 6 August 2026 release (local capture eqix-pr-1118.html) names 'the Hampton, Ga. project' and 'the Hampton facility' and describes a 20-year take-or-pay contract with Central Georgia EMC for a new high-voltage substation and two transmission lines, which would support announced. Georgia EPD's Air Protection Branch public advisory (comment deadline 2 October 2026; local capture ga-epd-pa0926-1.pdf) lists application 30303 for 'Equinix Atlanta Data Center' at 1100 Site Parkway, Hampton 30228, seeking an update to engine make and model and to an hour limit in permit condition 2.11, which implies an air permit already exists; an air permit is not consent for the data-centre development. Trade reporting of August 2025 (RCR Wireless interview, seen in search results and not captured) quotes an Equinix xScale executive describing daily earthmoving to make the site pad-ready, so admitting the project as announced in August 2026 would understate site preparation reported a year earlier, and no in-window record of a construction stage was found (Equinix's Q2 2026 results of 29 July 2026 are outside the window; Q3 results are not yet published). No official parcel or address point was reached: Henry County's parcel service was not located without a search form and the Georgia DCA DRI application host disallows all paths in robots.txt.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within 85 days) Equinix, Henry County, City of Hampton or Georgia EPD record of a physical stage (site preparation, building permit with works, construction, completion) for the Hampton campus, plus an official parcel or address-point locator for 1000-1100 Site Parkway (for example the Henry County tax parcel owned by an Equinix entity).

entries.candidate: STACK MIL08B, Siziano (second unit on the MIL08 campus; BLD_8 in the July 2026 VIA air study)
entries.reason: The MIL08 site is added in this fragment with MIL08A. The VIA documents (November 2025 summary, 10 September 2026 notice, 2 October 2026 ISS opinion) describe MIL08B (5 MW IT, 6 generators) as being built, and Esri imagery shows works at its outline, but each statement restates the proponent's documentation rather than reporting a dated observation of the works, and the imagery is undated. Only one project can be added to a site that is new in the same update.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window first-hand statement of MIL08B works or completion (STACK release, Comune di Siziano works record, or MASE monitoring report); then add it as a project on curated:stack-mil08-siziano-campus reusing that site's campus locator exactly.

entries.candidate: Equinix Settimo Milanese campus buildings ML5-ML6 (Equinix Italia), ML7-ML8 and ML9 (Equinix Hyperscale 2), Il Castelletto, Settimo Milanese (MI)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas. The ML10x air study (listed 12 October 2026) prints their building outlines and stacks about 140-350 m from the ML10x point and models a cumulative construction scenario for ML5-6 with ML10x, and Esri imagery shows an existing large building at the ML7 outline and earthworks at the ML9 outline, but no dated in-window statement of each building's stage was reviewed. The 2026-10-23 forty-fourth holds record that the ML5/ML6 VIA (ID_VIP 14093) has no in-window milestone and that MASE excluded an ML7 modification from VIA on 21 September 2026 without establishing a building stage. These buildings are on separate lots from ML10x and should not reuse its locator.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Equinix or authority record of operation, construction or consent for a named building, with its own filed outline or parcel locator.

entries.candidate: Operator location pages without dated versions: Vantage Ashburn I-III, New Albany OH1, Montreal I, Kwai Chung, Fo Tan and Cyberjaya I; Digital Realty SIN11, BCN1 and VIN02

The pages carry no structured publication or modification date (only sitemap lastmod values, which are bulk refreshes), and several describe planned campuses in the future tense (VA2, VA3, OH1); Vantage's Ashburn II page marker (39.9995041, -78.4392728) is a placeholder one degree from the Ashburn I marker. Internet Archive listings for the Digital Realty pages show no bounded in-window version. None supports a dated status.
